column4: Institute of Drafting Technologists
Sri Lanka (Incorporation)
To promote co-operation with organizations in or
outside Sri Lanka relating to Drafting Technology;
To  communicate  with  any  third  party  including
the State and its Agencies, and represent the interest
of  the  membership  on  matters  relating  to  the
Vocation of Drafting Technology;
To decide and/or to determine disputes arising from
violation of any rules prescribed under section 6 of
the  Body  Corporate  pertaining  to  the  general
conduct, discipline and the vocational activities of
the  members  of  the  Body  Corporate  and  to  take
appropriate action in terms of the said  prescribed
rules of the Body Corporate;
To  take  such  other  measures,  including  the
establishment  and  maintenance  of  data  banks  as
may be necessary for the benefit or advancement of
those who practice as Drafting Technologists in Sri
Lanka and abroad;
To  determine  a  scheme  of  assessment  for  and
conduct  of  continuous  professional  development
programmes for members;
To do all such other acts and things as are incidental
or conducive to the attainment of the above objects
or any of them.
